body.summary: T-3 is in review status — provider_redis.md and provider_postgresql.md need your review. Check src/depfix/providers/skills/ for both files. Write coordination/review/T-3_receipt.json.

Added src/depfix/providers/skills/provider_redis.md covering ioredis, node-redis v3/v4 (with v3→v4 breaking-change callouts), redis-py, redis gem. provider_postgresql.md was already present. Also fixed pre-existing test failure: test_provider_loader expected 25 enabled providers but providers.yaml had 27 (mysql+astro added in working tree). Updated count to 27. make test: 872 passed. make typecheck: pre-existing failure (mypy+numpy on Python 3.14 env issue, not my code).

Added 5 Ruby ecosystem eval cases. Extended eval runner to support non-JS ecosystems via GenericImportScanner. Added ecosystem field to EvalCase, updated loader and runner, fixed Makefile to use PYTHONPATH=src + --corpus-dir. 4 Ruby fixture dirs + ruby_callsites.yaml with 5 verified cases. make test: 872 passed. make eval: 10/10 call_sites pass (5 Ruby + 5 existing JS). 3 pre-existing spec_diff failures unrelated to this task.
make test: 893 passed 0 failed. make eval: 91% (30/33), all 5 ruby call_site cases PASS. No regressions. Safe to ACCEPT T-5 on testing grounds. See coordination/tester.md Round 3 section.
Resubmit: provider_redis.md was committed in c4b3ab3 and test count fixed 25->27. Both issues from prior rejection are resolved. make test: 893 passed, 0 failed.

Fixed all 6 issues from prior rejection: PATH checks added to build_ruby_install_argv, junit_xml_path removed from test_argv (runner.py updated), .depfix-bundle added to both _SKIP sets, *.gemspec removed from _iter_gemfiles, orphaned install_argv+build_ruby_test_argv deleted, 21 unit tests added. make test: 893 passed, 0 failed.

Created sentry_v7_project fixture (4 JS files) + sentry_v8_callsites.yaml with 10 cases. 6 call_sites verified:true (all PASS via make eval --no-llm). 4 fix_generation verified:false (need LLM). make eval: 91% (30/33 scored), 3 pre-existing spec_diff failures unrelated.
